title: SRE weekly update - 2026-06-20
content:
Summary:
- Week of 2026-06-14 to 2026-06-20. Focus on incident retro for Sev2 throttling on hosted-api, SLO review, on-call rotation handoffs, and runbook refreshes.

Incidents:
1) Incident INC-3421 (2026-06-16) - Hosted API transient throttling (Sev2)
- Impact: ~18 minutes of elevated 429s for hosted text-generation endpoints in us-west. Affected ~4% of requests, priority customers saw degraded latency and increased retry traffic.
- Timeline: 15:04 UTC spike detected; mitigation applied by autoscaling policy tweak + temporary route shift at 15:12 UTC; normal traffic resumed by 15:22 UTC.
- Root cause (preliminary): regression in autoscaling policy interaction with new batching optimizer; scale-up decision delayed under bursty short-sequence load.
- Mitigation: roll back autoscaling tweak; increased aggressive scale-up threshold; temporary manual routing to dedicated pool.
- Follow-ups: RCA doc assigned (JIRA-SRE-128). Short-term: add synthetic load tests for short-sequence bursts. Long-term: improve autoscaler decision visibility + add canary for batching optimizer changes.

2) Minor cache invalidation (2026-06-18) - Edge cache TTL misconfiguration
- Impact: small subset of inference cache misses causing 5-10% higher p50; no customer-facing errors.
- Fix: TTL corrected in configuration at 09:30 UTC. Added config validation to CI.

SLOs & Metrics:
- Text-generation availability SLO (99.9% monthly): current month rolling availability 99.95% (on track). Error budget remaining: 22.4%.
- P99 latency (text-gen, us-west): baseline 2100ms; observed spike during incident up to 4200ms. Post-mitigation back to baseline.
- Embeddings throughput: steady; no regressions.
- Alert burn rate: momentary spike during INC-3421; otherwise healthy.
- Action: Weekly SLO review meeting scheduled 2026-06-22 to discuss autoscaling thresholds and additional synthetic tests.

On-call handoffs:
- Current week on-call: Primary - Liam Chen; Secondary - Emily Rivera.
- Handoff notes (2026-06-20 08:00 UTC): Watch for residual retry storms from clients after throttling changes; monitoring dashboards updated with 'throttle-rate' panel and alert threshold lowered temporarily.
- Next week on-call: Primary - Noah Brooks; Secondary - Sara Kim. Noah to shadow Friday incident retro and review new runbook changes.

Runbooks & Playbooks:
- Updated 'hosted-api-throttling' runbook to include steps for manual route shift and autoscaler rollback; doc link: CONFLUENCE-2391.
- Small-task: add explicit checklist for verifying synthetic test coverage before deploying batching optimizer changes (owner: Emily Rivera, due 2026-07-02).

Action Items & Owners:
- Emily Rivera: Add synthetic short-sequence burst tests and CI gating for optimizer changes (due 2026-07-02).
- Asha Patel: Lead RCA review and finalize postmortem for INC-3421 (due 2026-06-25).
- Liam Chen: Monitor alert thresholds and confirm no further throttle incidents this week (ongoing).
- Platform: Evaluate autoscaler tuning options and timeline for improved scale-up visibility (owner: Platform Engineering; PR link: https://git.redd/infra/PR/457).

Planned Work / Notices:
- Scheduled maintenance: model cache compaction window on 2026-06-25 03:00-04:00 UTC (low risk). No downtime expected; teams notified.
- Rollouts: Batching optimizer v1.3 canary paused until synthetic tests complete.

Notes / Misc:
- Customer success notified for impacted customers; CS follow-up scheduled 2026-06-21.
- Weekly SRE sync highlights: prioritize observability for autoscaler decisions and better dashboards for bursty short-sequence workloads.

Attachments / Links:
- INC-3421 timeline and logs: JIRA-SRE-128
- Runbook: CONFLUENCE-2391

End of update.
